A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
A builder by practice.

Keith JanishGAME DEVELOPMENT + GAME DESIGN

I’m Keith, a Game Development graduate and Game Design master’s student at Full Sail University. I’m drawn to the point where code meets the player: how movement feels, how a system responds, and how a game makes its next step clear.

My work spans Unity and C# gameplay systems, Unreal Engine and C++ projects, and the UI that connects players to both. I enjoy tracking down the small issues that make a big difference to the experience.

I’m looking for an internship or entry-level opportunity to contribute to a game development team, learn from experienced developers, and keep building.
